name: Decaf Coffee
siboNotes: Plain decaf coffee is FODMAP-free and generally well-tolerated in SIBO. Avoid adding high FODMAP milk or sweeteners.
preparationTips: Use lactose-free milk or small amounts of regular milk if desired
Sweeten with glucose, maple syrup, or stevia instead of high-fructose sweeteners
Cold brew may be gentler on sensitive stomachs
Avoid adding inulin-containing creamers or sugar-free sweeteners with polyols
